# CodexAutoResume

> A portable Windows x64 utility that automatically resumes paused Codex desktop tasks when a supported right-pointing resume button is present, including interruptions described as at capacity.

Button recognition runs locally. The utility clicks only a strictly recognized resume triangle and checks the running square. It observes send arrows, voice waveforms and question panels without clicking. It does not modify service capacity, account quotas or model availability. CLI and browser automation are outside the current scope. Licensed under MIT.

Repository: https://github.com/ColinKiiim/codex-auto-resume

Downloads: https://github.com/ColinKiiim/codex-auto-resume/releases
